channel.title: AIArchive — model preservation news
channel.description: Captures, mirrors, takedown alerts and trending models, generated by the archive's automation

item.title: This week the archive captured 29 Tencent models, most of them the WeMM-Ecom family in 0.8B, 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B sizes, each in base, FP8, GPTQ, and GGUF variants, plus Hy4-flash and Hy4-flash-FP8. Also captured were openbmb/MiniCPM-OCR-1.0-DSpark and three inclusionAI models: Ling-3.1-flash-1019-singprobe, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-singprobe, and invoker-render-1.0. Nothing was mirrored and no alerts were raised; radar signals included a Show HN post for TrnRT, an open-source LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium.
